data.summary_zh: 云端版不再需要邀请：打开即注册，登录后直接进入工作台。同时新增登录前的公开配置接口与落地页骨架，首次访问不再先撞登录墙。
data.summary_en: The hosted edition no longer needs an invitation — sign up and land straight in the workbench. A public pre-login config endpoint and SPA shell mean first visits no longer hit a login wall.

data.title_zh: 桌面端 v1.3.1：Windows 安装链路实测通过
data.title_en: Desktop v1.3.1: Windows install path verified end to end
data.summary_zh: Windows 上跑通真实安装冒烟：静默安装 NSIS 包、启动应用、探活后端，三步全绿。打包产物的应用代码落在 resources/app，安装后能正常读取。
data.summary_en: A real Windows install smoke now runs end to end: silent NSIS install, app launch, backend readiness probe. Packaged app code lands in resources/app and reads correctly after install.

data.summary_zh: 修了三处会让使用者困惑的鉴权行为：密钥校验返回生效后的分组而非原始快照、付费档在预检接口上同样生效、401 响应不再重复携带认证头。空分组快照的密钥回落到社区档。
data.summary_en: Three auth behaviours that confused users are fixed: key validation now returns effective groups rather than the raw snapshot, paid tiers gate the pre-check endpoint too, and 401 responses no longer carry duplicate authentication headers. Keys with empty group snapshots fall back to the community tier.

data.title_zh: MCP 网关转为独立维护分支
data.title_en: MCP gateway moves to an independently maintained lineage
data.summary_zh: 从上游 1.32.0 起建立独立演进分支：既保留上游的协议实现，又能按我们的接入与计费需求迭代，不再被动跟随上游节奏。
data.summary_en: Starting from upstream 1.32.0 we maintain our own lineage: the protocol implementation stays upstream's, while access-control and metering changes follow our own cadence.

data.title_zh: 行业数据源批次二：纽约、芝加哥与英国电力三源上线
data.title_en: Industry sources, batch two: New York, Chicago and UK power go live
data.summary_zh: 三个公开数据源接入并点亮：纽约市与芝加哥市的开放数据（Socrata 平台），以及英国电力系统的日度温度数据。接入走独立出口错峰，不影响既有源的稳定性。
data.summary_en: Three public sources are connected and live: New York City and Chicago open data on Socrata, plus daily temperature data from the UK electricity system. Fetches use a separate egress lane so existing sources keep their stability.

data.title_zh: 官网产品页改为直达登录入口
data.title_en: Product page now links straight to sign-in
data.summary_zh: 产品页的云端入口从「联系开通」改为直接进入登录页，与自助注册开放保持一致；本地部署的入口与文档保持不变。
data.summary_en: The cloud entry on the product page now goes straight to sign-in instead of asking for contact, matching the open self-service sign-up. The self-host entry and docs are unchanged.
